name: @substrate-system/markdown-toc
description: Generate a markdown TOC (table of contents) with Remarkable.

scripts.build-esm: esbuild src/index.ts src/cli.ts src/markdown-toc.ts src/insert-markdown.ts --format=esm --metafile=dist/meta.json --keep-names --tsconfig=tsconfig.build.json --outdir=./dist --sourcemap && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.build.json --outDir dist
scripts.version: auto-changelog -p --template keepachangelog --breaking-pattern 'BREAKING CHANGE:' && git add CHANGELOG.md README.md

author: Jon Schlinkert (https://github.com/jonschlinkert)
